descs.rates.productivity_factor: MANAGEMENT LEVER. How much of the work product and AI absorb instead of consulting. Lowering it does NOT change the price: it reduces the internal HOURS available and raises the effective rate (base rate ÷ factor), so the productivity gain is margin. 0.92 = base; 0.80 = demanding target. Propagates to Internal B4.
descs.rates.dev_per_hour: The company's BASE rate. The real rate the team must reach is this ÷ productivity factor.
descs.rates.analysis_per_hour: BASE rate of the functional analysis. The effective one is this ÷ productivity factor.
descs.deal.pais: ISO code of the deal's country (e.g. ES). Informational, per deal or template.
descs.deal.locale: Language of the proposal (es/en/fr/nl). Drives the texts and the currency format.
descs.deal.num_usuarios: Scales the Odoo licence and Field Service (€/user). Empty = the rep is asked.
descs.deal.num_usuarios_light: Employees on a Light User licence (HR record only, or employee features only: leave, expenses, attendance, planning, POS). Their own annual line; the users selector never rescales it. Empty or 0 = no Light line. Every proposal splits staff into full and Light users.
descs.deal.vertical: Switches on the vertical block in the proposal (today: 'inbuilt' = construction). Empty = no vertical.
descs.deal.num_usuarios_app: Users of the Inbuilt mobile App (site operatives and supervisors). They do not usually match the Odoo users.
descs.deal.involvement_dias: Days per week the CLIENT's team puts into the project (1 = base case; range 1–2.5). Feeds the involvement bars of the proposal; tunable per app via extra_data.app_overrides.<APP>.involvement_pct (days × 20 = %).
descs.deal.fecha_propuesta: Date of the document (dd/mm/yyyy). Empty = date of generation.
descs.deal.fecha_decision: Anchor of the commercial calendar: team assignment, kick-off, analysis and implementation are derived from it using the weeks on Internal. Format dd/mm/yyyy.
descs.deal.anchor_asignacion: Overrides the derived milestone. Free text (e.g. '29 Jul'). Empty = decision + 3 working days.
descs.deal.anchor_kickoff: Overrides the derived milestone. Free text. Empty = first Monday of the month after the decision.
descs.deal.anchor_analisis: Overrides the derived milestone. Free text (e.g. 'Sep–Oct'). Empty = kick-off + the sheet's analysis weeks.
descs.deal.anchor_implantacion: Overrides the derived milestone. Free text. Empty = end of analysis + the sheet's implementation weeks.
descs.deal.anchor_soporte: Overrides the derived milestone. Free text. Empty = 'after go-live'.
descs.support.salida_pct: Percentage of the project PRICE (analysis + implementation) billed as go-live support (support, migrations and training). On price, not on hours: that way the productivity factor never moves it.
descs.poc.pct: Price of the 'Essential Flow' POC as a % of the functional analysis.
descs.adjust_band_pct: The rep's free adjustment margin, per app or global. Above it, management sign-off is required.
descs.rates.onsite_day_rate: Rate per on-site day. Mentioned only in the terms and conditions.
descs.migration.pct: % of (apps + flagged developments) forming the monthly migration fee.
descs.migration.months: Months in the renewal cycle (fee = % ÷ months, rounded up to €10).
descs.vertical.inbuilt.pack_oneshot: The complete construction vertical on Odoo (BC3, certifications, measurements, margin per site). Closed price with no hours; INCLUDES the mobile App. Appears only if deal.vertical = inbuilt.
descs.vertical.inbuilt.app_oneshot: The mobile App on its own (without the pack). If the pack is ticked the App is included and is not charged separately.
descs.ia_catalog.exclusive.mcp.oneshot: Rollout of the MCP connector. Mutually exclusive with the AI Starter Pack.
descs.ia_catalog.exclusive.mcp.monthly: Monthly maintenance of the MCP. Goes into the recurring block.
descs.ia_catalog.exclusive.starter_ia.oneshot: AI training and infrastructure. Mutually exclusive with the standalone MCP (it includes it).
descs.ia_catalog.addons.field_service.oneshot: Field service mobile App. Only if the Project app is ticked.
descs.ia_catalog.addons.field_service.monthly_: Monthly per-user licence for Field Service. Goes into recurring.
descs.recurrent_lines.odoo_license.fallback_am: Rate PER USER and year: the Custom plan, annual billing, LIST price (Spain: 334.80 = 27.90 × 12). Never the first-year discount. Standard is 178.80. The engine computes the total: rate × no. users. NEVER put the total here.
descs.recurring_monthly.odoo_light_user: Odoo list price of the Light User (Spain: 4.90 €/user/month = 58.80 €/year, same on annual or monthly billing, no first-year discount). The engine computes rate × 12 × no. Light Users.
descs.recurring_monthly.mcp: Monthly MCP fee if it is ticked.
descs.recurring_monthly.field_service_per_user: Monthly per-user Field Service fee if it is ticked.
descs.maintenance_plan.base_monthly: Base fee of the maintenance plan.
descs.maintenance_plan.included_hours: Support hours included in the base fee.
descs.maintenance_plan.extra_hour: Rate for an hour outside the bundle.

recurrent_descs.dyn_cloud: High-performance hosting, daily backups and SSL security.
recurrent_descs.maintenance: Functional support, incident resolution and updates.

dev_descriptions.integracion_fabricacion_api: Development of the integration between Odoo and your own manufacturing application via REST API. Includes the endpoints needed to sync stock, lots, production orders and actual consumption. Your manufacturing application keeps working as before, but connected to the rest of the ERP.
dev_descriptions.conector_shopify_facturacion: Integration with your Shopify store to automate the invoicing of online sales. Shopify orders are imported automatically into Odoo, generating the corresponding invoices without manual intervention. Your website stays on Shopify, but invoicing and accounting are centralized in Odoo.
dev_descriptions.integracion_transportistas_comparador: Direct connection with your carriers' APIs to generate shipping labels, check rates and track parcels from Odoo. Includes an automatic comparator that selects the best rate for each shipment based on weight, destination and urgency.

dev_fallback: Custom development to cover specific needs of your business.
